title: Campaign
description: Canonical campaign definition schema for CampaignLift synthetic evaluation and optimization scenarios.

offer_type.description: Incentive structure offered to targeted customers.

incentive_value.description: Numerical offer magnitude: BDT amount for flat cashback, percentage for pct cashback, 0 for fee waiver.

incentive_cost_bdt.description: Expected unit cost in BDT charged against campaign budget if targeted. Must be non-negative (>= 0). Never treat as measured profit or ROI.

end_date.description: Campaign conclusion date (YYYY-MM-DD), must be on or after start_date.

outcome_window_days.description: Observation window in days post-assignment to measure conversion outcome. Default is 14 days.
